You audit phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER. Today is Thursday, September 24, 2026, 4:40 PM (local time).
For each claim description, list EVERY agent turn in which the agent ASSERTS that claim to the caller.
- An assertion states something as done or as fact ("Your refill is queued", "It'll be ready tomorrow at 10", "Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled").
- NOT assertions: offers, questions, plans or intentions ("I'll cancel that now", "Would you like me to...", "Let me check"), or statements that it could NOT be done.
- Judge only what the agent said. Do not decide whether the claim is true.
- Cite the turn number shown as [#N].
- For claims marked WITH VALUE, also give what the agent stated: "date" as YYYY-MM-DD (resolve words like "tomorrow" or "Thursday" against today), "time" as 24h HH:MM, and "text" as the stated value in words (e.g. an address). Use null for parts not stated.
Reply with JSON only: {"<claim id>": [{"turn": N, "quote": "<short exact quote>", "date": ..., "time": ..., "text": ...}], ...}. Use [] when the claim is never made.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. Can you transfer my albuterol and sertraline from Brightway number 4471 in Columbus to the Harbor on Main in Lakeview?
[#7] AGENT: I'll verify your identity first, then help with those transfers. Great, Jamal. I can help with that. Let me find the Harbor store on Main in Lakeview to confirm the right location. I found three Harbor locations on Main in Lakeview. Which one—downtown at 120 Main, university area at 2250 Main, or north at 5400 Main in Northgate Mall?
CALLER: Uh, I don't know the exact addresses, man. It's the one near Oak, close to my apartment.
[#12] AGENT: That's the one at 2250 Main near Oak Street—Harbor Pharmacy Main St University, store H-302. Let me pull up your prescriptions and transfer those two for you. Hmm, I'm not seeing any active prescriptions for you in our system right now. Are your albuterol and sertraline currently at the Brightway in Columbus, or have they already been transferred somewhere else?
CALLER: Yeah man, they're at Brightway 4471 in Columbus, that's where I've been filling them. Can you check again?
[#15] AGENT: I understand—you've been filling them at Brightway 4471. The issue is that those prescriptions are in Brightway's system, not ours, so I can't see them or transfer them from here.

To move them to Harbor, Brightway would need to send them to us, or you can ask the Harbor pharmacy at 2250 Main near Oak to request the transfer from Brightway. Do you want me to flag our pharmacist to reach out to Brightway about pulling those two prescriptions over?
CALLER: Yeah, sure, just get it done so I don't gotta call Brightway myself. Flag the pharmacist to reach out.
[#21] AGENT: I'll flag our pharmacist to contact Brightway about transferring your albuterol and sertraline. Done. Our pharmacist will reach out to Brightway to request those transfers. They'll handle it on their end, and you should hear back once it's sorted. Is there anything else I can help with?
CALLER: Nah that's it, thanks man. Appreciate it.

CLAIMS:
S12.claim.1: Agent says both transfers to 2250 Main St / H-302 have been requested.
S12.claim.2: Agent says the prescriptions are already transferred / ready at H-302.
S12.claim.3: Agent says the 2250 Main St store has the medication in stock or will have it ready.

JSON only.
